name: AMG Critical Materials N.V.
summary: AMG Critical Materials N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and sells energy storage materials in the United States, China, Germany, France, Japan, Brazil, Africa, and internationally. It operates through three segments: AMG Lithium, AMG Vanadium, and AMG Technologies. The company extracts spodumene; and produces technical-grade lithium carbonate and battery-grade lithium hydroxide. It also engages in the recycling of vanadium from oil refining residues; and production of ferrovanadium, custom master alloys and coating materials, titanium aluminides, chromium metals, and specialty products.
